summary: BifrOSt has a WebKit-style web view for SDK apps (WebProcessPool over the Servo engine) and a full Browser app with tabs, history, bookmarks, reader mode and private windows. It has no Safari extension, content blocker, Reading List, authentication session, universal link, or standard in-app Safari sheet API.

features.apple: Safari Services landing (web content in your app); SFSafariViewController is the Safari-owned variant
features.note: Load, navigation, state and events exist. No hover, drag selection, context menus, select/file panels, or cancel of a load (Servo 0.7.0 limits).

features.bifrost: none; springboard/apps/browser/src/main.rs has its own Settings sheet, not an SDK component
features.note: An SDK app has to build its own web view and chrome. No system-provided browser sheet with Safari's controls.

features.feature: Safari web extensions and Safari app extensions
features.apple: SFSafariExtension, SFSafariExtensionHandler, SFSafariExtensionManager, SFSafariPage, SFSafariTab, SFSafariWindow, SFExtensionMessageKey, Web Inspector extensions
features.note: No extension host, page or tab proxies, or extension messaging. The browser has no plug-in API.

features.apple: SFContentBlockerManager, SFContentBlockerState, creating a content blocker
features.bifrost: none; a search for content-blocker and blocklist terms in springboard/apps/browser and springboard/sdk/src found nothing
features.note: No content-blocking rules API and no ad or tracker blocking.

features.bifrost: none; docs/bifrost-ui.md:503 lists Add to Reading List only as a Safari share target that BifrOSt does not offer
features.note: Reader mode exists in springboard/src/shell/browser/reader.rs, but it has no saved list and no SDK API.

features.apple: SFAuthenticationSession (deprecated) and its completion handler, SFAuthenticationError
features.note: Nothing shares a one-time login between the browser and apps. The Apple successor (ASWebAuthenticationSession) is not in this framework.

features.apple: SFUniversalLink, applinks service, Associated Domains Entitlement
features.bifrost: none; springboard/sdk/src/workspace.rs opens URLs but has no association lookup
features.note: No mapping from a website to an installed app and no link handoff. Apps cannot claim web domains.

features.bifrost: springboard/apps/browser/src/prefs.rs (browser.homepage, browser.searchEngine, browser.restoreSession in the app's own UserDefaults)
features.note: Preferences are private to the Browser app. Other apps cannot read them and there is no system-wide Safari settings object.

features.feature: Browser app features (history, bookmarks, tabs, private windows)
features.apple: Safari app (not in the framework; the framework exposes only the extension-side proxies)
features.bifrost: springboard/apps/browser/README.md (round 55: private window via --private); springboard/src/shell/browser/nav.rs; docs/bifrost-ui.md 'Browser history, bookmarks and address suggestions'
features.note: A working Browser app with history capped at 5000 and frecency ranking, bookmarks, session restore and reader mode. Those are app-level, not SDK API, and there is no History or Bookmarks menu API.

features.apple: Adding a web development tool to Safari Web Inspector; Creating Safari Web Inspector extensions
features.note: Script evaluation, screenshots and input exist for the Browser's own inspector. There is no public extension point for adding a tool to it.

features.apple: Importing data exported from Safari (bookmarks, saved passwords)
features.note: No import path for Safari bookmarks or passwords. Browser bookmarks are stored as TSV under ~/.local/share/bifrost-browser/.

features.feature: Home Screen bookmarks and availability checks
features.note: Home Screen bookmarks are an iOS feature. The availability and version checks depend on Apple's Safari Services versions and have no BifrOSt counterpart.

gaps: No standard in-app browser sheet (SFSafariViewController equivalent) for SDK apps
No content-blocking rules API and no ad or tracker blocking
No Safari Reading List (SSReadingList) or Reading List share target
No web extension host, Safari page or tab proxies, or extension messaging
No universal links or associated-domain lookup for apps
No shared authentication session between the browser and apps
Browser preferences (SFSafariSettings) are private to the Browser app, with no system-wide object
Web view input and rendering gaps: no hover, drag selection, context menus, select or file panels, or load cancel (docs/bifrost-ui.md 'Web view')
